motion_and_scroll_effects.engine: Lenis smooth scrolling + GSAP 3 ScrollTrigger + CSS 3D Transforms

effects.name: Opening Hero Parallax
effects.behavior: Smooth scale animation from 1.05 to 1.0 on scroll, accompanied by fade-in editorial copy

effects.name: Horizontal Coverflow Drag/Scroll
effects.behavior: Horizontal inertia scroll for wedding cards with smooth snap and hover lift

effects.name: Interactive 3D Pressbook Sheet Flip
effects.behavior: CSS perspective 1200px 3D page flip animation with next/prev buttons and click toggles

effects.name: Services Pinned Sticky Section
effects.behavior: Sticky position pin while scrolling through horizontal service cards and dynamic background crossfades

effects.name: Testimonial Card Expand
effects.behavior: Smooth height transition for long testimonials with 'Read full review' state toggle

effects.name: Video Story Auto-play & Sound Control
effects.behavior: Hover/Tap play trigger with volume toggle overlay button

effects.name: Quick Search Modal & Floating Floating Contact Buttons
effects.behavior: Glassmorphism floating pills with smooth backdrop blur fade and micro-bounce on click

wordpress_admin_content_strategy.elementor_compatibility: Fully guarded with wvn_elementor_editing() condition to allow full page overrides whenever an admin chooses to build custom pages using Elementor.

responsive_and_accessibility_guardrails.contrast: Strict WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for body copy against paper backgrounds, minimum 3:1 for large display titles.
responsive_and_accessibility_guardrails.touch_targets: All navigation links, theme toggles, and modal buttons have minimum 48px height x 48px width touch areas.
responsive_and_accessibility_guardrails.header_navigation: Pill navigation remains visible on desktop. Mobile hamburger converts to slide-over panel with backdrop blur, full screen aria-hidden and keyboard ESC dismiss.
responsive_and_accessibility_guardrails.reduced_motion: CSS media query @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables GSAP scroll scrub and heavy 3D rotations gracefully.
responsive_and_accessibility_guardrails.performance: Hero image preloaded with fetchpriority='high'. All secondary section images use loading='lazy' and decoding='async'.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements, buttons, nav items, search inputs, modal toggles, and CF7 form controls MUST include kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.
